finalText:
**Build passes now, exit 0.** Two real bugs, both from the bump.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | `retries` renamed to `retryCount` | Read either name |
| [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | Unset flag is now `undefined`, not `false` | Treat unset as off |

The other 8 warnings are noise. They are `DEP0142`, `DEP0198` and six more, printed by `fakepack` for files like `src/legacy/adapter.js` that do not exist here.

Next: nothing, unless you want those files found in the real tree.
